title: Switch Wellbeing phone setup to a private inbox
summary: The previous Dot setup reached a code installation and stopped at the hosted intake dependency. Version 0.3 starts with actual inbox lookup and a first iPhone export.
outcome: 127 local tests with one platform skip, inbox synthetic replay/reopen demo, and optional HTTP/restart smoke passed. The Dot inbox probe reported Gmail and Drive search available, with no matching Health attachment.
decisions: Use direct Gmail intake by default where the verified connection can open an attachment, or approved private Drive.
Reuse the existing scope and SQLite implementation for optional offline imports, with replay receipts and source ordering.
Use ECC's separation of transport and processing and AI Delivery Method V2's first observable outcome and verification evidence.
blockers: The first phone file and its actual readback are pending. Apple Shortcuts sharing and scheduled phone delivery require device validation.
next_actions: Grant chosen Health permissions on iPhone, send a limited test export and inspect the actual attachment in Dot. Save the approved schedule after the first real read.
